templates.name: API Build
templates.description: Fetch code, lint, run tests, build, and deploy an API service.

steps.name: fetch
steps.prompt: Fetch the source code for the spec: {{spec}}.

steps.name: lint
steps.prompt: Lint the code and return issues found.

steps.name: test
steps.prompt: Run the test suite and return pass/fail results.

steps.name: build
steps.prompt: Build the deployment artifact from the tested code.

steps.name: deploy
steps.prompt: Deploy the artifact and report status.

templates.name: Microservice Build
templates.description: Scaffold a new microservice, configure it, run tests, and package for deployment.

steps.name: scaffold
steps.prompt: Scaffold a microservice from the spec: {{spec}}.

steps.name: config
steps.prompt: Generate configuration files (Dockerfile, CI, env) for the scaffolded service.

steps.name: test
steps.prompt: Run tests on the configured microservice.

steps.name: package
steps.prompt: Package the microservice into a container image.
